meta.name: alternative-model-generation
meta.description: Generate alternative model formulations by relaxing, replacing, or generalizing specific assumptions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成替代模型公式，通过放松或替换假设
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在做数学建模或理论推导，需要探索不同假设下的模型变体。
copy.tagline_en: Generate alternative model formulations by relaxing or replacing assumptions.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能在你给出原始模型和想放松的假设后，生成替代的模型表述（放松、替换或概括假设）。
howto.when: 当你提供一个原始模型字符串和一个要放松的假设字符串时触发。

say.text: 请放松模型中的线性假设，生成一个替代模型。
say.note: 输出放松该假设后的模型变体。

say.text: 基于这个原始模型，替换假设X为Y，得到新模型。
say.note: Claude将执行替换并生成新版本。

howto.what_en: Generate alternative model formulations by relaxing, replacing, or generalizing specific assumptions based on an original model and an assumption to relax.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide an original model (string) and an assumption to relax (string).

say_en.text: Relax the linearity assumption in the model and generate an alternative.
say_en.note: Outputs a model variant with that assumption relaxed.

say_en.text: Based on this original model, replace assumption X with Y to get a new model.
say_en.note: Claude will perform the replacement and produce a new version.
